messages:
dave: FYI we're going to flip the eu-central egress match rule set in ~15m. this will introduce a deny-by-default for infra-ephemeral subnets and route fallback traffic through a regional nat pool. expect extra rule-eval logs.
yuri: what's the rollback plan if GPU warm pools start queuing?
dave: rollback = revert route table + remove deny rules. i'll keep it manual for the canary. also we'll only enable for subnet eu-c-1 first.
mona: conntrack pressure is my main worry. last time we saw onboarding drop when table hit 100%. canary must include conntrack and warmup metrics.
zack: agree. recommend a pre-canary sysctl bump on warm nodes and a temp natgw target increase. quick cmds: ```
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000
# temporary tcp established timeout for provisioning spikes
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=432000
```
dave: thanks. ops-bot: plan queued -> PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge/1601 :truck: 
ops-bot: preflight checks: natgw target groups, route propagation, conntrack quota, cloudwatch ingest budgets... found: audit logging QPS for control-plane +38% projected. security-bot: projected CloudWatch data bytes +1.5GB/hr for eu account, ~+42% ingestion.
yuri: will that push us over the observability budget for the month? need a quick cost mitigation knob.
security-bot: we can toggle off per-rule match logging for ephemeral-subnets and keep sampled flow logs. that reduces bytes ~60% for those subnets. compliance flagged, though.
mona: if sampled logs satisfy e-discovery retention for 90 days, ok. we need a tiny doc update.
zack: also throttle KMS calls from the onboarding agent. when thousands of nodes call decrypt at once we see HSM proxy queueing. set env: `KMS_BACKOFF_MS=150` `KMS_MAX_BACKOFF_MS=1800`
oncall: putting a pager on standby: /pager/warmup-degradation. runbook stub: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-canary-eucentral. i'll add the checklist and rollout gates.
dave: executing subnet canary now (eu-c-1). watch these dashboards: /dash/warmup-onboard-rate, /dash/conntrack-usage, /alerts/kms-retry-errors. react with :white_check_mark: when stable.
yuri: initial traffic shows ~20% conntrack increase, natgw CPU normal. onboarding rate steady.
mona: KMS retries spiked but under threshold, no HSM queueing seen. CloudWatch ingest up ~33% (not 38).
zack: keeping the temporary sysctl live for canary. if onboarding latency > 5s for 3 consecutive minutes we rollback.
dave: canary hold for 10m. so far green. security-bot: compliance review started for reduced logging mode. expect OK if sampling retained.
yuri: recommend adding a feature flag to disable per-subnet auditing during high-churn windows (infra#3050).
dave: filing infra#3050 now. ops-bot: canary complete after 14m: no rollback required. promoting config to eu-c-2 gradually.
mona: post-action items: 1) add sampling config to audit pipeline 2) update runbook 3) monitor CloudWatch bytes next 48h and revert sampling if unexpected queries for e-discovery.
dave: thanks team. will post cost delta in #costs in an hour. closing thread.
